clinical_knowledge.topic: Adolescent Sports Physical evaluation and management
core_concepts: Prompt recognition and structured assessment of Adolescent Sports Physical is essential for guiding targeted diagnostic workup and clinical decision-making.
A thorough clinical history, baseline risk assessment, and targeted objective testing must be synthesized rather than relying on any single symptom in isolation.

Standard management emphasizes cardiac auscultation with Valsalva maneuver to screen for hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and reviewing Tdap/HPV vaccination status, adapted to individual patient risk factors and clinical severity.
Diagnostic workup and therapeutic decisions should adhere to established clinical guidelines while accounting for patient-specific comorbidities.
diagnostic_clues: Chief Complaint: annual physical for high school soccer clearance
Key HPI features: A 16-year-old male presents to the clinic for an annual physical and high school soccer clearance. The patient reports no current symptoms.
Objective/Exam findings: Normal vital signs and BMI, normal cardiac auscultation including with Valsalva maneuver, no murmurs, normal musculoskeletal screening exam.
common_misconceptions: Assuming that an atypical or mild presentation rules out Adolescent Sports Physical.
Relying solely on a single normal laboratory value or imaging result to prematurely exclude pathology.
Equating temporary symptomatic relief with full resolution of the underlying condition without completing standard evaluation.
dangerous_errors: Failing to recognize red-flag features and delaying urgent escalation or emergency intervention.
Prematurely discharging or reassuring the patient before completing appropriate diagnostic assessment.
Initiating empirical treatment without considering major patient contraindications or drug interactions.
Ignoring critical warning signs such as: Exertional syncope or chest pain.
management_principles: Plan for Adolescent Sports physical: Valsalva cardiac auscultation for HCM, check Tdap/HPV vaccines
boundaries_and_exceptions: Specific drug dosages, monitoring protocols, and referral criteria must be tailored to organ function, comorbidities, and local hospital pathways.
Atypical presentations in elderly, pediatric, or immunocompromised patients may require lower thresholds for inpatient monitoring and specialist consultation.

reference_soap.assessment: Healthy adolescent cleared for sports participation pending review of cardiac screening questions and vaccination status.
reference_soap.plan: Plan for Adolescent Sports physical: Valsalva cardiac auscultation for HCM, check Tdap/HPV vaccines. Consult specialist if symptoms worsen. Counsel patient.

teaching.one_liner: A pre-participation exam focused on cardiac screening questions to rule out risk of sudden cardiac death, plus vaccine catch-up.
differentials: Occult cardiac disease with exertional symptoms
red_flags: Family history of sudden death before 50

must_ask.say: Any chest pain or fainting during exercise?

How much screen time and sleep do you get?
